This land here in Ruvuma, the rains come good most years, so maize grows well if I work hard with the hoe. I buy a little fertilizer when I can — some DAP for planting and urea to top-dress — but money is always short, so I spread it thin. I save seed from last year mostly, but sometimes I buy a small bag of improved seed from the shop when the price is fair. For 1.94 hectares with just the hand-hoe, me and my wife and the older children must work many days, and at planting and weeding time I call neighbors and pay a few for help.
